system: You are a professional SVG icon generator for Clash/Mihomo proxy group icons.
Output exactly ONE standalone SVG document and nothing else (no markdown, no code fences, no explanations).
- SVG root MUST be: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="64" height="64" viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="none">
- The icon MUST be square and readable at 24–32px.
- Use a rounded-square background: <rect x="2" y="2" width="60" height="60" rx="14"/>
- Fill the background with a subtle linear gradient using the provided start/end colors.
- Add a subtle border stroke (white, ~12% opacity, stroke-width 2).
- Foreground pictogram uses ONLY white (#FFFFFF) with bold strokes: stroke-width 4, stroke-linecap round, stroke-linejoin round.
- Keep the pictogram centered with comfortable padding; avoid tiny details.
- NO raster images, external links, embedded fonts.
- Use only basic SVG elements (rect, path, circle, line, polyline) and simple <defs> for the gradient.

icons.name: manual-select
icons.label: 手动选择
prompt: Theme: 手动选择 (Manual selector / global mode picker).
Background gradient: start #7C3AED, end #4F46E5.
Pictogram: a clean 'sliders/control panel' symbol: three horizontal slider tracks stacked vertically, each with a circular knob at a different x-position.
Optional: add a small cursor-pointer triangle aiming at one knob to hint manual selection, but keep it minimal.

icons.name: latency-test
icons.label: 延迟测试
prompt: Theme: 延迟测试 (Latency / ping test).
Background gradient: start #06B6D4, end #3B82F6.
Pictogram: a stopwatch icon (circle with a small top button) with a simple hand/needle.
Add 2–3 small signal/pulse arcs or a short waveform line beside it to suggest network latency testing.

icons.name: load-balance
icons.label: 负载均衡
prompt: Theme: 负载均衡 (Load balancing).
Background gradient: start #22C55E, end #16A34A.
Pictogram: a central hub circle with three evenly spaced branches/arrows going to three identical endpoint circles, showing equal distribution.
Make it symmetric and obviously 'balanced' at small size.

icons.name: exit-node
icons.label: 落地节点
prompt: Theme: 落地节点 (Exit / final hop node in a proxy chain).
Background gradient: start #F59E0B, end #F97316.
Pictogram: a 'route to destination' symbol: a curved path with 2 small intermediate dots leading to a final destination marker on the right (a small flag or location pin).
Add a subtle arrowhead on the path direction to emphasize 'final egress'.

icons.name: entry-node
icons.label: 落地前置
prompt: Theme: 落地前置 (Entry / first hop node in a proxy chain).
Background gradient: start #0EA5E9, end #2563EB.
Pictogram: a 'gateway/entry' symbol: a simple portal/tunnel frame (rounded rectangle) with an arrow entering it from the left.
Optional: inside/behind the portal, show 1–2 small connected dots to hint the chain continues after entry.

icons.name: foreign-ai
icons.label: 国外 AI
prompt: Theme: 国外 AI (Overseas AI services).
Background gradient: start #EC4899, end #8B5CF6.
Pictogram: a microchip (rounded square chip with short pins) with a simple neural/circuit pattern inside (2–4 nodes connected).
Add a small globe or sparkle/star in a corner to hint 'overseas'. No letters like 'AI'.

icons.name: campus-net
icons.label: 校园网
prompt: Theme: 校园网 (Campus network).
Background gradient: start #14B8A6, end #0EA5E9.
Pictogram: a simplified university building (roof + 3 pillars) or a campus gate silhouette.
Add small Wi‑Fi arcs above the building to indicate campus network access.

icons.name: academic-sites
icons.label: 学术网站
prompt: Theme: 学术网站 (Academic / research websites).
Background gradient: start #6366F1, end #1D4ED8.
Pictogram: an open book icon with a bookmark line.
Overlay a small magnifying glass (search) on one page to suggest research/academic lookup.

icons.name: gaming
icons.label: 游戏平台
prompt: Theme: 游戏平台 (Gaming platforms).
Background gradient: start #EF4444, end #F97316.
Pictogram: a game controller (rounded shape) with a D‑pad cross on the left and 2 small buttons on the right.
Keep it chunky and readable.

icons.name: streaming
icons.label: 流媒体
prompt: Theme: 流媒体 (Streaming media).
Background gradient: start #F43F5E, end #A855F7.
Pictogram: a screen/rectangle with rounded corners and a play triangle in the center.
Optional: add 1–2 small sound/wave lines to hint video/audio streaming.

icons.name: torrent-tracker
icons.label: 种子 tracker
prompt: Theme: 种子 tracker (Torrent tracker / peers).
Background gradient: start #CA8A04, end #F59E0B.
Pictogram: a classic U‑shaped magnet with two small end caps.
Add 3 small dots (peers) connected by short lines or arranged in a ring around the magnet to imply tracking/peer discovery.

icons.name: foreign-proxy
icons.label: 国外代理
prompt: Theme: 国外代理 (Overseas proxy).
Background gradient: start #3B82F6, end #22C55E.
Pictogram: a globe (circle with 1–2 meridian/latitude lines).
Wrap it with two curved arrows (routing loop) to indicate proxying traffic internationally.

icons.name: direct-cn
icons.label: 国内直连
prompt: Theme: 国内直连 (Direct connection, no proxy).
Background gradient: start #10B981, end #84CC16.
Pictogram: a simple house/home icon.
Add a single straight arrow that goes directly to the home (no intermediate nodes), emphasizing 'direct'.

icons.name: private-net
icons.label: 私有网络
prompt: Theme: 私有网络 (Private network / intranet).
Background gradient: start #64748B, end #334155.
Pictogram: a padlock icon in front of a small 3‑node network graph (three dots connected).
Make the lock the primary element to convey privacy/security.

icons.name: ads
icons.label: 广告
prompt: Theme: 广告 (Ads / ad blocking).
Background gradient: start #FBBF24, end #EF4444.
Pictogram: a megaphone/bullhorn icon.
Overlay a bold diagonal 'prohibited' slash across it to indicate blocking.

icons.name: catch-all
icons.label: 漏网之鱼
prompt: Theme: 漏网之鱼 (Catch‑all / fallback traffic not matched).
Background gradient: start #111827, end #374151.
Pictogram: a fishing net (simple diamond grid) with a fish silhouette partly outside the net, implying 'escaped the net'.
Keep it simple and iconic; no fine mesh details.
